styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. One per page. Handlee, `ink`. Clamp 48 to 72px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title. Handlee, `ink`. Clamp 38 to 52px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card title and beat title. Handlee, `ink`. Clamp 30 to 36px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small title inside a card or inset page. Handlee.

styles.name: margin-note
styles.sample: we wrote this one at midnight
styles.usage: Marginalia beside a paragraph, `rose-text`, up to -2 degrees of rotation. Handlee.

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: Generate font combinations with deep learning
styles.usage: Subheading under a Handlee heading. Handlee, `ink-muted` or `ink`.

styles.name: sub-sm
styles.usage: Small subheading, member names. Handlee.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A living room for language. Come for one chapter, stay for the whole story.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph under a heading. Antic Slab, `ink`. Clamp 19 to 22px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Click to create a new pairing, lock the fonts you want to keep, and edit to choose by hand.
styles.usage: Reading text, 36rem measure. Antic Slab, `ink` or `ink-muted`. Clamp 17 to 18px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Meets every Thursday in the garden room.
styles.usage: Card text, secondary paragraphs. Antic Slab.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions. Antic Slab, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a heading. Type in sentence case and set capitals with CSS `text-transform: uppercase`. Antic Slab, `rose-text` or `ink-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Navigation links and buttons. Capitals by CSS. Antic Slab.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Credits, dates, fine print. 12px is the floor. Antic Slab, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Dates and counts. Antic Slab with tabular-nums.

styles.name: body-hi
styles.usage: Devanagari reading text. Laila (Antic Slab has no Devanagari). No letter-spacing.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statement. Finesse Roman, centred, at most one line or two. Clamp 72 to 144px. Display tier only.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Large section statement. Finesse Roman. Clamp 56 to 104px.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quote. Finesse Italic, `ink`, centred. 36px minimum.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: One loud word or event title. Finesse Oblique. 40px minimum.

styles.name: numeral-year
styles.usage: Decorative year in `rose`, with the plain year also in the page text. Finesse Flair. 56px minimum.

styles.name: ornament
styles.usage: One or two words of ornament. Finesse Future. Never navigation or instructions.

styles.name: write-en
styles.usage: English text that writes itself (tegaki). Caveat. 28px minimum.

styles.name: write-hi
styles.usage: Hindi text that writes itself (tegaki). Tillana. 28px minimum.

styles.name: signature
styles.usage: Signatures and attributions. Parisienne. 32px minimum.

styles.name: flourish
styles.usage: One-line flourish. Italianno. 48px minimum.
